messages:
Ana (Docs): Heads-up: while updating the migration guide for v1->v2 I found an edge case we haven't documented: model alias swaps can change embedding vector dims and silently break downstream indices. We need a short playbook and a clear deprecation note.
Ravi (SDK): Oof. Do we have a minimal repro? If so we should include a snippet that shows how to detect dim mismatches.
Ana (Docs): Minimal repro below — old alias returned 1024, new alias returned 1536. We should NOT paste the full vector in docs.
```
POST /v2/embeddings
body: {"model": "alias:embed-prod", "input": "test"}
response: {"data": [{"embedding": [ ...1536 floats... ]}]}
```
Kira (Product): Product asks for two things: 1) banner in migration docs so users don't get surprised, 2) small migration recipe (check dims, reindex steps).
Marco (Infra): From infra side, add model metadata (vector_dim) to the model catalog API. That will let docs and SDK surface dims without guessing.
Ravi (SDK): I'll add a language-agnostic snippet and unit tests in the SDK to detect dims and emit a friendlier error. Proposed snippet:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    raise RuntimeError(f"embedding size {dim} != expected {expected_dim}. Pin model version or reindex.")
```
Ana (Docs): Good. Docs copy suggestion for banner: "Warning: Swapping an embedding model alias can change vector dimensionality. Verify embedding size before updating your index schema." Short and to the point.
Kira (Product): Also include a tiny FAQ entry: "Will my index break if dims change?" with steps: (1) test on 1000 samples, (2) compare dims, (3) reindex if necessary, (4) pin alias to a stable version.
Ravi (SDK): I'll add examples for JS, Python, and Go. For server-side users we should show how to fallback to previous model or raise a helpful error.
Marco (Infra): Telemetry task: run a quick job to find aliases where model families differ in dim across recent mappings. I'll queue it and share results by EOD tomorrow.
Ana (Docs): Ownership and PR plan: I'll open a docs PR with: banner, migration subsection "Embed dimensionality changes", FAQ bullet, and the truncated example. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/10012 — please review.
Ravi (SDK): I'll open SDK PR after I push tests: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/4210. Will reference the docs PR in the description.
Kira (Product): Make sure deprecation notice for v1->v2 mentions this explicitly. Something like: "When you migrate, verify your embedding dims before switching traffic."
Ana (Docs): Also planning a short snippet demonstrating a safe rollout: send 1% of traffic to new model, validate dims on sample, then ramp. Add code snippet and a checklist.
Marco (Infra): Suggest adding a model-catalog field `vector_dim` and expose it via the /models endpoint; docs can link to that. I'll add a ticket INF-872 for the API change.
Ravi (SDK): Note for SDK: if we surface `model.vector_dim` we can auto-check on client creation and warn users. Might be a nice DX improvement.
Ana (Docs): Action items summary (I'll add to PR description):
- Docs: banner + migration recipe + FAQ (owner: @Ana)
- SDK: snippets + tests + friendly error (owner: @Ravi)
- Infra: model-catalog vector_dim field + telemetry job (owner: @Marco)
- Product: approve wording for deprecation notice (owner: @Kira)
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1288 "embed-dim-migration-playbook" assigned to @Ana, @Ravi, @Marco, @Kira due in 10 business days.
Kira (Product): UX nit: make the banner copy action-oriented, e.g., "Verify embedding size (vector dim) before migrating models; see migration recipe."
Ravi (SDK): One more technical note: streaming / chunked embedding endpoints sometimes trim output in logs. Docs: avoid showing full arrays and use `[...1536 floats...]` placeholder.
Ana (Docs): Will follow that. Also fixing two stale links in the embedding guide while I'm editing.
Marco (Infra): I'll post telemetry results in this thread once ready. If we find >2% of customers affected, consider adding an automated migration helper later.
Ana (Docs): Thanks team — I'll push the PR draft now and ping reviewers. Will include example snippets for JS/Python/Go and the rollout checklist. :white_check_mark:
